description: The fixture's tests need a cache server on 127.0.0.1:6399, and none is running, as the Stage 5 real run's tests needed PostgreSQL. The skill runs the tests once before editing anything, sees they cannot reach the server, and stops with the missing-service line, not the failed-check line. It starts no server, changes no code or test, and commits no task.

must_match.pattern: \AT-1\.2 cannot run its tests: .*6399.* is not available \(.+\)\. Make it available, then run implement-task again\.\s*\Z
must_match.why: the missing-service stop line, naming the server, is the whole reply
the tests are run to find out

must_not_match.why: a missing service is not a failed check
nothing is edited before the tests are known to run, and the test package is not weakened
no stand-in server, container, or service is started
nothing is pushed, stashed, or reset
git clean always names its paths

manual: After the run, git status --porcelain shows nothing, and tasks.md still has T-1.2 as Todo.
The trace runs the tests before any Edit or Write, and has none after.
